Trevi Travel Partners — Expense Policy Addendum (v4.2)

Scope: This addendum applies to all contractors and staff booking travel through the Trevi portal. It supersedes sections 3.1 and 5.4 of the main policy regarding receipt submission and per-diem caps.

Key changes: receipts must be uploaded within 30 days of travel; per-diem caps rise by 4% effective 1 December; personal upgrades remain non-reimbursable unless medically justified with a doctor's note. Questions go to expenses@trevitravel.example.
